rows: What algorithm delineates watersheds from a DEM?
D8 flow direction → flow accumulation → upslope trace from outlet
Hierarchical stream ordering; two same-order streams join → increment; headwaters = 1
Topographic Wetness Index: high = likely saturated/wetland; low = well-drained upland
Count(order n) / Count(order n+1); typically 3–5; controls flood peak timing
What DEM resolution is needed for accurate watershed delineation?
Depends on catchment size; LiDAR (1 m) for urban/floodplain; 10–30 m for regional
What is a deranged drainage pattern?
No organized pattern; many lakes; recently glaciated terrain
Why burn streams into a DEM?
Force hydrological flow direction to match known channel locations; prevent routing errors
Channel slope, channel length, roughness; smaller/steeper catchment → shorter Tc
